name: discord_get_messages
description: Recent messages in a channel, newest first. Returns [{ id, content, author: { id, username, bot }, timestamp }]. Use `after` with the last id you saw to poll for replies. Reading message content needs the Message Content intent enabled for the app when the bot did not write the message.

channel_id.description: Discord channel id, e.g. '1180000000000000000'. Right-click the channel -> Copy Channel ID (Developer Mode on), or use discord_list_channels.

after.description: Return messages posted after this message id (for polling).

before.description: Return messages posted before this message id (for paging back).
